name: Nori's Mug
summary: In Dun Morogh, Nori Pridedrift sends his mug out with a warm drink. Travelers carry scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter in Anvilmar, then bring the empty mug back to its owner.

sections.title: A Courier's Return
sections.body: Nori Pridedrift lends his mug for a delivery through Dun Morogh's freezing passes. The mug carries hot mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter in Anvilmar, where the drink offers comfort against the bitter cold. Once Durnan has drained it, the mug makes the return trip to Nori. He reminds travelers that mugs do not grow on trees, and expects his sturdy drinking vessel back.

faq.q: What is Nori's Mug used for?
faq.answer: Nori's Mug carries scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter in Anvilmar. After Durnan drinks it, the empty mug goes back to Nori Pridedrift.
Nori Pridedrift owns the mug. He expects travelers to return it after delivering his drink to Anvilmar.

faq.q: Why does Nori insist on getting the mug back?
aliases: why does nori want it back
faq.answer: Nori expects the mug back because, as he says, mugs do not grow on trees. He wants his borrowed drinking vessel returned to him.

faq.q: What was drunk from the mug?
faq.answer: The mug held scalding mornbrew, a warm drink for warding off Dun Morogh's biting cold.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know a warm drink can comfort you in Dun Morogh's storms. Nori also expects you to bring his mug back.
